message.content: 截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009 年上映），其全球票房已突破 29 億美元（約 2.92 億美元）。在 2021 年《阿凡達》在中國大陸重新上映後，重新超越了此前的冠軍《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019 年），成為迄今為止票房最高的影片。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?" They want the highest grossing movie worldwide. The answer: "Avengers: Endgame" (2019) with $2.798 billion worldwide. But we need to confirm if there's any updated data. As of 2023, "Avatar" (2009) had $2.92B worldwide, but after re-releases, "Avatar" regained top spot. Actually, as of 2023, "Avatar" is the highest-grossing film worldwide with $2.92B. However, "Avengers: Endgame" was the highest until 2021 when "Avatar" surpassed it. So the answer: "Avatar" (2009). But the user might want the highest worldwide gross. So we can answer: "Avatar" (2009) with $2.92B worldwide. Or mention "Avengers: Endgame" was second. We can also mention that "Avatar" has been re-released and regained top spot.
